name: Home Safety Aging
description: Produces a comprehensive home safety assessment checklist for aging in place, covering fall prevention, mobility accommodation, bathroom safety, lighting improvements, emergency contact setup, and room-by-room hazard identification. Generates prioritized modification plans with urgency levels and cost estimates. Use when the user asks about making a home safer for an elderly person, fall prevention, or aging-in-place modifications. Do NOT use for care facility evaluation (use care-facility-evaluation), medical assessment of fall risk (consult a physician), or full home renovation planning.
